verdict.rationale: Retell documents a versioned public REST API (for example POST /v2/create-phone-call) with an interactive "Try it" reference, official Node.js and Python SDKs claiming full voice and chat endpoint coverage, and a dated deprecation-notices page tracking API breaking changes. missing for 10: a publicly served OpenAPI spec (the internal "openapi-final" document returns 404 at every probed URL), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.

The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the interactive playground ("playground":{"display":"interactive"}) with a "Try it" runner per endpoint, e.g. "Create a new outbound phone call" (POST /v2/create-phone-call)
Retell publishes a dated deprecation-notices page tracking "Retell API, SDK, and billing deprecations and breaking changes"
